body.name: Finite rational outer-interval algorithm
body.construction: Given counts \(k\), compute \(D_p(k)\), \(\mathcal R_{\beta}(k)\), and the saturated likelihood \(L_{\rm sat}\); choose a positive rational \(t_{\rm lo}\) with \(L_{\rm sat}e^{-4/\beta}/2\le t_{\rm lo}\le L_{\rm sat}e^{-4/\beta}\), partition \([0,1/4]^4\) into rational boxes of max-diameter \(h\) with \(L_{\rm lip}h\le\eta/8\) and \(\sum_j n_jh\le t_{\rm lo}/4\), retain every box whose rational likelihood upper enclosure meets \(t_{\rm lo}\) and whose intersection with \(\mathcal P_0\) is nonempty, enclose \(G\) at a rational feasible point of each retained box, enlarge by \(L_{\rm lip}h\), and return the rational hull; return \([0,0]\) when the retained list is empty.
